title: Researchers sketch an AI control safety case for an internal agent
summary: Korbak, Clymer, Hilton, Shlegeris and Irving sketch a control safety case: a structured argument that a model cannot subvert control measures such as monitoring to cause an unacceptable outcome, illustrated on a hypothetical LLM agent deployed internally at an AI company that must not exfiltrate sensitive information. The evidence is a control evaluation in which a red team deliberately designs models to exfiltrate data in a proxy of the deployment environment, and the argument rests on three claims: the red team adequately elicits exfiltration capabilities, the control measures remain at least as effective in deployment, and model performance is extrapolated conservatively to the probability of exfiltration in deployment.
